desc:
Isolated footstep sounds on gravel

part of my venture into non-weapon related foley. I'm working on a small sfx library akin to classic stock sound effect libraries. I want it to be something on the same quality as the hollywood edge's libraries, or at least close to it. a lot of sounds I've previously released here will be included, as well with a lot of new ones of course. this is something I recorded for said library. more will be released soon!

and as always, credit will always be appreciated - though it's not required at all. if you do choose to credit me, please do so under the name "serøutōnin//deprivəd", or alternatively "seroutonin//deprived".

ily guys <3

-sero
